scope: Static resource relocation audit; no Unity/compiler/tests executed.

digest_format.inventory: SHA-256 of sorted UTF-8 lines: old_path<TAB>file_sha256<TAB>byte_count<LF>. Paths are repository-relative.

current.sidecar_rule: For each non-null guid row, old + .meta moved to new + .meta unchanged; meta hash/size describe that baseline sidecar. Null fields preserve MISSING_IN_BASELINE evidence; new sidecars for those assets are tracked separately in metadata_completion, not attributed to the base.

archive.mapping_rule: Every listed relative file path moves unchanged from old_root + path to new_root + path. Excludes extracted current files. V7 contains only its retired wrapper meta; Levels.meta remains active and unchanged.

unchanged_scoped.description: All other Assets/Art, Art.meta, Resources.meta, and the existing Levels.meta remain unchanged.

runtime_validation: NOT_RUN — user prohibited Unity, build/compiler, automated tests, screenshots and playthrough execution.

integration_obligations.Scripts_owner: Replace current versioned Resources.Load paths in GameArt, LevelLoader, DevOptions and BirdOverlay; no V5/V6 fallback or legacy gate crop. Preserve existing key routing.
integration_obligations.Editor_Tests_owner: Use new resource paths and retain six fallback PNG import policies; do not apply uncompressed/full-rect policy to the six compressed legacy imports. All 108 baseline-missing bird metas are now copied unchanged from the authorized Mac primary source. Seven primary-modified overlay metas were explicitly excluded; their importer correction remains C-owned.

compatibility: No save data or storage keys changed. Persisted v5/v6/v7 identifiers remain compatibility IDs, not parallel game implementations.

metadata_completion.authorization: User followup on 2026-11-04: read-only copy only the 108 missing bird metas from the existing Mac primary checkout. Never write/move/delete primary files; exclude all seven primary-modified overlays.
metadata_completion.baseline_status: MISSING_IN_BASELINE; current.files null metadata remains an honest base record.
metadata_completion.path_rule: Copy source_root + filename to destination_root + filename unchanged. Each filename minus .meta corresponds to a baseline-missing PNG in current.files.
metadata_completion.settings_comparison: Compare the entire TextureImporter mapping excluding internalIDToNameTable and spriteSheet.sprites (per-image generated IDs, names and geometry). Compare all other spriteSheet fields as well. All 108 are textureType=8 and spriteMode=1.
